startup_protocol.1_PORT_CHECK: Probe 127.0.0.1:8089 before launch. If port is occupied: HALT preparation immediately with PORT_8089_IN_USE. Strictly NO termination of foreign processes.
startup_protocol.2_PROCESS_SPAWN: Start llama-server with Start-Process -PassThru to capture $proc.Id. Record PID, executable path, start timestamp, and command line to [SYSTEM_TEMP]/pilot_embedding_server.pid.
startup_protocol.3_HEALTH_PROBE: Wait for /health HTTP endpoint on 127.0.0.1:8089 up to 15s.

termination_protocol.1_IDENTITY_CHECK: Read recorded PID; verify process exists, its executable path matches [AI_ROOT]/release/v1/bin/llama-server.exe, and start time matches recorded session.
termination_protocol.2_WRAPPER_RESOLUTION: If binary acts as launcher, resolve child worker PIDs within the dedicated session process tree.
termination_protocol.3_SOFT_STOP: Send soft termination signal / wait 5 seconds for clean exit.
termination_protocol.4_CONTROLLED_FORCE: If process remains active after 5s, execute Stop-Process -Id $proc.Id -Force. NEVER execute Stop-Process -Name llama-server or taskkill /IM.
termination_protocol.5_CLEANUP_ISOLATION: Diagnostic logs and EIG telemetry preserved first. Cleanup covers ONLY [SYSTEM_TEMP]/flying_rag_isolated_pilot_corpus and requires operator approval. Existing audit copies are untouched.
